about: When a catalog permission entry's condition is met: one table read by the console's permission-conditions.test.ts and the platform's PermissionConditionsTest, so a chart's runner policy and a stack plan's added permissions decide every entry the same way. Each case names the condition's spec_field_set (null for an entry with none), the specs of every manifest of the kind, and whether the entry is needed.

cases.name: an entry without a condition is always needed
no manifest of the kind needs nothing
the JSON spelling a rendered manifest uses meets a snake_case condition
the proto spelling meets it too
an empty list is not set
an empty string is not set
zero is not set
false is not set
null is not set
true is set
a non-zero number is set
a field the manifest leaves out is not set
any one manifest of the kind setting the field needs the entry
a nested path reads the JSON spelling at every level
a present object is set, even an empty one
a nested field under an empty object is not set
a path that ends inside a scalar is not set
a path through a list is set when any element sets the rest
a path through a list is not set when no element sets the rest
a map inside a list element is set when it has entries
